description: This file contains unit tests for date-related utility functions (`formatDate` and `getStandardTimezone`) used in the core/util/helper module of the project. The tests verify the correctness of date formatting and timezone calculations.

methods.name: format::HH:mm
methods.description: Tests formatting of a date to 'HH:mm' string.

methods.name: format::HH.mm
methods.description: Tests formatting of a date to 'HH.mm' string.

methods.name: format::YY-MM-DD HH.mm
methods.description: Tests formatting of a date to 'YY-MM-DD HH.mm' which is expected to fail and return null.

methods.name: getStandardTimezone:+05:00
methods.description: Tests conversion of positive timezone offset (5 hours) to '+05:00' string.

methods.name: getStandardTimezone:+05:30
methods.description: Tests conversion of positive timezone offset (5.5 hours) to '+05:30' string.

methods.name: getStandardTimezone:-05:00
methods.description: Tests conversion of negative timezone offset (-5 hours) to '-05:00' string.

methods.name: getStandardTimezone:-05:30
methods.description: Tests conversion of negative timezone offset (-5.5 hours) to '-05:30' string.
